personality_one_liner: A high-trust, data-forward B2B platform defined by crisp white cards, precise typography, and a commanding deep navy authority.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native padding for a clean SaaS look. Ensure 16-24pt outer margins on screens. Elements within cards get 12-16pt. Touch targets strictly 44pt minimum.

do's: Use blur on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers over scrolling lists.
Use glass overlay on the primary hero KPI card if over a textured background.
dont's: Do not use glass on list rows, standard cards, or data tables. Keep data surfaces solid white for maximum legibility.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure entry point emphasizing trust with a deep navy abstract hero background.

states.error: Inline red validation text or error toast above the form.

screens.layout: Full-bleed abstract navy background at the top fading into a crisp white bottom sheet (radius `lg`) containing the JWT email/password form and seeded demo account chips. Form inputs use `surfaceTertiary` with no borders.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Role-specific command center featuring the undisputed hero metric and secondary KPI strips.

states.empty: N/A (KPIs show zero states with greyed-out sparklines).
states.error: Error boundary with a subtle retry button.

screens.layout: Top hero metric (e.g., Total Revenue or Open Orders) highly prominent. Below, a horizontally scrollable or wrapping grid of secondary KPI cards showing current value, delta (green/red), and a sparkline. Actionable alerts (e.g., '3 Kunden überfällig') surfaced directly below the hero.

screens.name: Kunden
screens.purpose: Admin/Sales view of all clients with fast search and high-density scannability.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty Rolodex/contact box + 'Keine Kunden gefunden'.

screens.layout: Sticky search bar at the top with filter chips (e.g., 'Aktiv', 'Überfällig'). Dense list rows (min 56pt height) showing customer name, ID, and a right-aligned status indicator (dot + text) for their ordering cycle.

screens.name: Kunden-Details
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific customer's conditions, pricing, and history.
screens.layout: Header with customer name and key info. Tabbed or segmented control layout switching between 'Konditionen' (Pricing logic/floor prices) and 'Historie' (Order history). Use a sticky bottom CTA for 'Neues Angebot erstellen' (Create Offer).

screens.name: Angebote
screens.purpose: Offer creation and admin approval workflows with strict floor-price logic.

states.empty: Illustration of a blank document + 'Keine offenen Angebote'.

screens.layout: List view of pending/approved offers using segmented controls. Create Offer view uses a clear form with inline validation if a price falls below the floor price. Admin view shows bottom sheet with 'Freigeben' (Approve) and 'Ablehnen' (Reject) actions.

screens.name: Bestellungen
screens.purpose: Customer role view for order history and fast 1-click reordering.

states.empty: Clean vector illustration of an empty cart + 'Noch keine Bestellungen'.

screens.layout: Stacked list of cards. Each card shows Date, Order ID, Total EUR, and Status badge (e.g., 'Versandt', 'In Bearbeitung'). Each card has a prominent 'Erneut bestellen' (Reorder) action button on the right or bottom.

screens.name: Auswertungen
screens.purpose: Analytics charts showing revenue, margin, and kg trends over time.
screens.layout: Segmented controls for timeframe (1M, 3M, YTD). Line charts or bar charts using the `brandSecondary` color for data visualization. A concise AI-like summary or highlight stat placed above the chart to provide context.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app uses German localization (de-DE) for all UI text, dates, and EUR currency formatting.
Implement Role-Based Access Control (Admin, Sales rep, Customer) via the seeded JWT login.
Adhere strictly to the deep navy/blue palette. Use `surface` (white) for cards to maintain the 'crisp white cards' request.
For KPI tiles and financial data: use `displayFontFamily` for the hero metric, and mono-variant or highly legible text for numeric values to ensure precise alignment.

For badge and status indicators (e.g., Offer approved, Invoice paid/overdue), use a `surfaceSecondary` or `surfaceTertiary` pill with a solid `success`/`warning`/`error` dot and matching colored text to avoid accessibility issues with pure background colors.
Floor-price logic in 'Angebote': include real-time form validation warning the user if the entered price falls below the calculated floor threshold.
Ensure the 'Erneut bestellen' (Reorder) flow on the Bestellungen screen is no more than two taps (List -> Confirm Sheet).
On charts (Auswertungen), prioritize scannability with clear tooltips and a summary stat directly above the chart.
